props.name: items
props.description: Every row's data. Only the visible slice is rendered.

props.name: itemHeight
props.description: Every row's height in pixels. Fixed heights are what keep this constant-time.

props.name: height
props.description: The list's visible height in pixels.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Draws one row, inside a box exactly `itemHeight` tall.

props.name: getKey
props.description: Stable identity per row. Defaults to the index.

props.name: overscan
props.description: Rows rendered past each edge, so a fast scroll does not flash blank.
